findings.problem: The hint does not rule out the equally common schützen ("Ich schütze dich" also works), and "watch over" could also suggest behüten or aufpassen auf.
findings.fix: hint: keep someone safe from harm (the be- word, not schützen)

back.target: to protect, to guard (a person or thing, keeping them from harm)
back.example: Don't be afraid, I'll protect you.

note: If schützen gets its own card later, its hint should point away from beschützen as well.
